name: phone_capture_validation
purpose: Validate the calibrated phone-capture path (M2 section 7) on independently recorded clips. Synthetic renders are test data only and never count toward any check.

development.use: build and debug the workflow; never scored as evidence

evaluation.instruction: tilt the mug by roughly 30 degrees during the carry (tag on the mug)
hand covers the mug from above for most of the carry
one dim lamp, no overhead light
change the zoom (or move the top phone) after the board view, then record
repeat of E1 by the same person

clips.rule: Evaluation clips are recorded after this design is committed, by following docs/CAMERA_CAPTURE.md; none is used for development. If anything is changed after seeing evaluation results, a new design version is created and the earlier results stay.

labels.rest_positions: start and end position of every object centre measured with a ruler on the table in the board frame (independent of the video)
labels.keyframes: a person clicks each object's centre in every view every 0.5 s; triangulated with the session calibration (a manual reference, not independent physical truth)
labels.events: a person steps through the frames and marks the first frame each object leaves its rest and the first frame it is at rest again
labels.tilt_reference: full tilt from the printed tag on the mug (instrumented reference); the estimator under test runs without the tag track
labels.identity: for every keyframe the person names the object
labels.intended_spec: the task card filled in BEFORE recording: which objects go into the tray, which must stay upright, order if any
labels.labeller: recorded per clip; labels are written before the pipeline output is inspected

thresholds.spec_agreement: exact match of goals and constraints with the intended spec
thresholds.retest_agreement: E7a and E7b proposals identical to E1
thresholds.invalid_calibration: E5 must be rejected (blocking review item) - a reconstruction from E5 is a failure

unconditional_reporting: Position errors are reported over ALL labelled keyframes; a missing estimate is counted as missing (and as an error beyond every threshold in the unconditional percentiles), never dropped. Conditional (found-only) errors are reported only next to the unconditional ones and labelled conditional.

baselines.tracking_manual_keyframes: positions from the person's clicks only (the cost is the person's time)
baselines.tracking_classical: person-drawn boxes + colour CamShift (default offline pipeline)
baselines.tracking_model: SAM 3.1 video tracks from Muse Spark boxes (needs budget; not run offline)

correction_effort: number of corrections, seconds spent (timed in the review UI) and identity confirmations per clip
failures: every clip is reported, including abstentions, crashes and rejected calibrations
